Strategy: Triple-ratio roomy preference. Prefer bins whose post-placement residual is near three item sizes, choosing the tightest among them; otherwise rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when a very roomy bin exists while the tightest fit is much tighter. It may help by spending very roomy bins on small items while preserving tight bins, but may fail if the roomy bin was needed for a later large item.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [4 * item - (r - item) if round((r - item) / item) == 3 else -(r - item) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Triple-ratio roomy preference: bins with round(rem/item)==3 win (tightest first), else Best Fit.
